# DEED OF LEASE FOR COMMERCIAL PREMISES

THIS DEED OF LEASE is made and executed at <Place of Execution> on this <Day> day of <Month>, 2026,

BY AND BETWEEN

1. SAMPLE ESTATES PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, bearing CIN U00000MH2020PTC000000, having its registered office at 10 Example Road, Fictional Nagar, Mumbai 400001 (hereinafter referred to as the "Lessor", which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context, include its successors and permitted assigns) of the ONE PART;

AND

2. DEMO RETAIL LLP, a limited liability partnership registered under the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008, bearing LLPIN AAA-0000, having its office at 22 Placeholder Lane, Testpur, Pune 411001 (hereinafter referred to as the "Lessee", which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context, include its successors and permitted assigns) of the OTHER PART.

---

### RECITALS

A. The Lessor is the absolute owner of the commercial unit more particularly described in Schedule I (the "Premises").

B. The Lessee has approached the Lessor to take the Premises on lease for running a retail store, and the Lessor has agreed to grant the lease on the terms set out below.

---

### 1. GRANT AND TERM

1.1 The Lessor hereby grants to the Lessee a lease of the Premises for a term of five (5) years commencing on 1 January 2027 (the "Commencement Date").

1.2 Lock-in: Neither Party shall terminate this Lease during the first thirty-six (36) months (the "Lock-in Period"), save as provided in Clause 7.

### 2. RENT AND ESCALATION

2.1 The Lessee shall pay a monthly rent in accordance with the following schedule, exclusive of GST:

| Lease Year | Period | Monthly Rent (INR) | Escalation |

| :--- | :--- | ---: | :---: |

| Year 1 | Jan 2027 – Dec 2027 | 2,00,000 | — |

| Year 2 | Jan 2028 – Dec 2028 | 2,10,000 | 5% |

| Year 3 | Jan 2029 – Dec 2029 | 2,20,500 | 5% |

| Year 4 | Jan 2030 – Dec 2030 | 2,31,525 | 5% |

| Year 5 | Jan 2031 – Dec 2031 | 2,43,101 | 5% |

2.2 Rent shall be paid in advance on or before the 7th day of each calendar month by bank transfer to the following account:

| Particular | Detail |

| :--- | :--- |

| Account Name | SAMPLE ESTATES PRIVATE LIMITED |

| Bank | \<Bank Name\> |

| Account Number | \<Account Number\> |

| IFSC | \<IFSC Code\> |

2.3 Late payment: Any rent not paid within fifteen (15) days of its due date shall carry interest at <Interest Rate>% per annum until paid.

#### 3. SECURITY DEPOSIT

3.1 The Lessee shall pay an interest-free refundable security deposit as follows:

| Instalment | Amount (INR) | Due Date |

| :--- | ---: | :--- |

| First | 6,00,000 | On execution of this Deed |

| Second | 6,00,000 | On or before the Commencement Date |

| TOTAL | 12,00,000 | — |

3.2 The deposit shall be refunded within thirty (30) days of the Lessee handing over vacant possession, after deducting:

  - (a) any unpaid rent or charges;

  - (b) the cost of repairing damage beyond normal wear and tear, being:

    (i) damage to fixtures listed in Schedule II; and

    (ii) damage to the structure caused by the Lessee's fit-out works; and

  - (c) any unpaid electricity, water or maintenance bills.

### 4. LESSEE'S OBLIGATIONS

The Lessee shall:

1. use the Premises only for lawful retail purposes;
2. obtain and maintain the shop and establishment registration and trade licence;
3. not sub-let or assign the Premises without the Lessor's prior written consent; and
4. keep the Premises insured against fire and allied perils.

### 5. LESSOR'S OBLIGATIONS

The Lessor shall:

1. pay all property taxes on the Premises;
2. carry out structural repairs within fifteen (15) days of written notice; and
3. ensure the Lessee's quiet enjoyment of the Premises.

### 6. MAINTENANCE AND CHARGES

6.1 The Lessee shall pay the following charges directly to the society or the authority concerned:

| Charge | Payable By | Frequency | Approximate Amount (INR) |

| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: |

| Maintenance | Lessee | Monthly | 15,000 |

| Electricity | Lessee | As per meter | Actuals |

| Water | Lessee | Quarterly | 3,000 |

| Property Tax | Lessor | Annual | 48,000 |

### 7. TERMINATION

7.1 After the Lock-in Period, either Party may terminate this Lease by giving three (3) months' written notice.

7.2 The Lessor may terminate this Lease forthwith if:

  - (a) the rent remains unpaid for two (2) consecutive months; or

  - (b) the Lessee commits a material breach and fails to cure it within thirty (30) days of notice.

### 8. STAMP DUTY AND REGISTRATION

This Deed shall be registered under the Registration Act, 1908. Stamp duty and registration charges shall be borne equally by the Parties.

### 9. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTES

9.1 This Deed is governed by the laws of India.

9.2 Disputes shall be referred to a sole arbitrator under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The seat of arbitration shall be Mumbai.
